title: Build or Adopt? Custom-Built vs. General-Purpose LLM Agent Harnesses for Automotive GUI Testing
abstract: arXiv:2610.33636v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As general-purpose LLM agent harnesses mature, organizations must decide whether to continue developing in-house systems or adopt existing alternatives. We study this decision at Volvo Group for GUI testing of Android-based in-vehicle infotainment (IVI) systems. We compare a production, custom-built harness with two general-purpose harnesses, Claude Code and OpenCode, keeping the tools, accessed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and the models the same. We evaluate the harnesses with up to four models on Volvo's IVI test cases and on open-ended tasks in public apps (Google Maps, Booking.com), and interview ten practitioners: developers, the product owner, and testers. On Volvo's stepwise IVI tests, general-purpose harnesses match the custom-built harness in success but vary more across runs. Their inference cost per task is 2.6-10.7 times higher, yet the engineering effort they save outweighs this: for a nightly IVI regression

translated_title: 自建还是采用？面向汽车GUI测试的定制化与通用LLM智能体框架对比
translated_abstract: 随着通用LLM智能体框架日趋成熟，组织必须决定是继续开发内部系统还是采用现有的替代方案。我们在沃尔沃集团针对基于Android的车载信息娱乐（IVI）系统的GUI测试研究了这一决策。我们将一个生产环境中的自建框架与两个通用框架（Claude Code和OpenCode）进行比较，同时保持通过模型上下文协议访问的工具和所使用的模型一致。我们使用多达四种模型，在沃尔沃的IVI测试用例以及公开应用（Google Maps、Booking.com）中的开放式任务上对这些框架进行了评估，并采访了十位从业者，包括开发人员、产品负责人和测试人员。在沃尔沃的分步式IVI测试中，通用框架的成功率与自建框架相当，但在不同运行之间的波动更大。它们的单任务推理成本高出2.6至10.7倍，但其节省的工程工作量足以抵消这一成本：对于夜间IVI回归测试……
tldr: 该研究在沃尔沃集团对比了自建LLM智能体框架与通用框架（Claude Code、OpenCode）在车载信息娱乐系统GUI测试中的表现，发现通用框架成功率相当但成本更高、波动更大，然而其节省的工程投入足以弥补成本劣势。
en_tdlr: This study compares a production custom-built LLM agent harness with general-purpose alternatives (Claude Code, OpenCode) for GUI testing of automotive IVI systems at Volvo Group, finding that general-purpose harnesses match success rates despite higher cost and variance, while their engineering effort savings outweigh the cost disadvantage.
